title: 電波陣列相關器
subcategoryTitle: 天文儀器與科學感測器
summary: 以 ALMA 的 64 天線基線相關器與 VLA 的 WIDAR 相關器為參照，說明可見度如何由兩天線電壓的互相關產生、幾何延遲與條紋旋轉如何即時補償、3 位元量化與 FX 架構如何決定靈敏度與運算量，再把相位／頻帶校正、時脈分配與端到端驗收整理成可交接的工程紀錄。
summaryEn: Using the ALMA 64-antenna baseline correlator and the VLA WIDAR correlator as references, the course explains how visibilities arise from cross-correlating two antennas' voltages, how geometric delay and fringe rotation are compensated in real time, how 3-bit quantisation and the FX architecture set sensitivity and compute load, and then organises phase and bandpass calibration, clock distribution and end-to-end acceptance into a handoff record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「互相關、可見度與 (u,v) 取樣」與「延遲補償、條紋旋轉與相干損失」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cross-correlation, visibility and (u,v) sampling" and "Delay compensation, fringe rotation and coherence loss": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 互相關、可見度與 (u,v) 取樣：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Cross-correlation, visibility and (u,v) sampling: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「可見度與 (u,v) 平面」如何決定電波陣列相關器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Visibility and the (u,v) plane” determines the key performance of “Radio-array correlators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相關器把天線 i 與 j 的電壓做時間平均的互相關 ⟨v_i·v_j*⟩，得到複數可見度 V(u,v)；依 van Cittert–Zernike 定理，它是天空亮度分佈在空間頻率 (u,v) = B_proj/λ 上的傅立葉分量。N 台天線同時提供 N(N−1)/2 條基線，地球自轉讓每條基線在 (u,v) 平面上掃出一道弧線，於是影像的解析度由最長基線決定、可偵測的最大角尺度由最短基線決定、視場則由單天線主波束決定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「可見度與 (u,v) 平面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The correlator forms the time-averaged cross-correlation ⟨v_i·v_j*⟩ of the voltages from antennas i and j, giving the complex visibility V(u,v); by the van Cittert–Zernike theorem this is the Fourier component of the sky brightness at spatial frequency (u,v) = B_proj/λ. N antennas provide N(N−1)/2 simultaneous baselines, Earth rotation sweeps each one along an arc in the (u,v) plane, so the image resolution is set by the longest baseline, the largest detectable angular scale by the shortest and the field of view by the single-dish primary beam. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Visibility and the (u,v) plane”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ALMA 64 台天線給 64×63/2 = 2016 條基線，50 台 12 m 天線給 1225 條，VLA 27 台給 351 條。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The 64 ALMA antennas give 64×63/2 = 2016 baselines, 50 of the 12 m antennas give 1225 and the 27 VLA antennas give 351.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每台天線各自成像後再疊加，就等於干涉陣列的影像。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Imaging with each antenna and co-adding equals the interferometric image." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「可見度與 (u,v) 平面」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Visibility and the (u,v) plane”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每台天線各自成像後再疊加，就等於干涉陣列的影像。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「電波陣列相關器」的「互相關、可見度與 (u,v) 取樣：原理與系統邊界」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出試件、激發、光路或訊號路徑與讀出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「觀測站：找回微弱訊號」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與校正件識別、暗場或零點、原始訊號與取樣設定的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Cross-correlation, visibility and (u,v) sampling: mechanism and system boundary” in “Radio-array correlators”. Draw the specimen, excitation, optical/signal path and readout boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Observatory: Recover a Faint Signal” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for reference-artifact identity, dark/zero records, raw signals and sampling settings, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「互相關、可見度與 (u,v) 取樣」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cross-correlation, visibility and (u,v) sampling" is correct?
options: 每台天線各自成像後再疊加，就等於干涉陣列的影像。
相關器把天線 i 與 j 的電壓做時間平均的互相關 ⟨v_i·v_j*⟩，得到複數可見度 V(u,v)。
延遲可以在相關與平均之後再修正，不會損失相干性。
optionsEn: Imaging with each antenna and co-adding equals the interferometric image.
The correlator forms the time-averaged cross-correlation ⟨v_i·v_j*⟩ of the voltages from antennas i and j, giving the complex visibility V(u,v).
Delay can be corrected after correlation and averaging without losing coherence.
quiz.explanation: 相關器把天線 i 與 j 的電壓做時間平均的互相關 ⟨v_i·v_j*⟩，得到複數可見度 V(u,v)；依 van Cittert–Zernike 定理，它是天空亮度分佈在空間頻率 (u,v) = B_proj/λ 上的傅立葉分量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The correlator forms the time-averaged cross-correlation ⟨v_i·v_j*⟩ of the voltages from antennas i and j, giving the complex visibility V(u,v); by the van Cittert–Zernike theorem this is the Fourier component of the sky brightness at spatial frequency (u,v) = B_proj/λ. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 互相關、可見度與 (u,v) 取樣：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cross-correlation, visibility and (u,v) sampling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「可見度與 (u,v) 平面」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Visibility and the (u,v) plane” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ALMA 64 台天線給 64×63/2 = 2016 條基線，50 台 12 m 天線給 1225 條，VLA 27 台給 351 條。在 230 GHz（λ = 1.3 mm）、最長基線 16 km 時解析度 λ/B = 1.3e−3/16000 = 8.1e−8 rad ≈ 17 mas；最短基線 15 m 的最大角尺度 ≈ 18″；12 m 天線主波束約 23″。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The 64 ALMA antennas give 64×63/2 = 2016 baselines, 50 of the 12 m antennas give 1225 and the 27 VLA antennas give 351. At 230 GHz (λ = 1.3 mm) with a 16 km longest baseline the resolution is λ/B = 1.3e−3/16000 = 8.1e−8 rad ≈ 17 mas; the 15 m shortest baseline gives a largest angular scale of about 18″, and the 12 m primary beam is about 23″. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：觀測一顆點源校正器：校正後所有基線的可見度振幅應相同、相位應為零，與基線長度無關；畫出該次觀測的 (u,v) 覆蓋圖並與排程模擬比對；對點源計算閉合相位，應在雜訊內為零。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Observe a point-source calibrator: after calibration every baseline should show the same visibility amplitude and zero phase independent of baseline length; plot the (u,v) coverage of the observation and compare with the scheduling simulation; compute closure phases on the point source, which should be zero within noise.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: ALMA 64 台天線給 64×63/2 = 2016 條基線，50 台 12 m 天線給 1225 條，VLA 27 台給 351 條。在 230 GHz（λ = 1.3 mm）、最長基線 16 km 時解析度 λ/B = 1.3e−3/16000 = 8.1e−8 rad ≈ 17 mas；最短基線 15 m 的最大角尺度 ≈ 18″；12 m 天線主波束約 23″。
knowledge.textEn: The 64 ALMA antennas give 64×63/2 = 2016 baselines, 50 of the 12 m antennas give 1225 and the 27 VLA antennas give 351. At 230 GHz (λ = 1.3 mm) with a 16 km longest baseline the resolution is λ/B = 1.3e−3/16000 = 8.1e−8 rad ≈ 17 mas; the 15 m shortest baseline gives a largest angular scale of about 18″, and the 12 m primary beam is about 23″.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「互相關、可見度與 (u,v) 取樣」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cross-correlation, visibility and (u,v) sampling", which statement holds?
options: 相關器的運算量與天線數成正比。
FFT 的各通道彼此獨立，頻譜洩漏可以忽略。
ALMA 64 台天線給 64×63/2 = 2016 條基線，50 台 12 m 天線給 1225 條，VLA 27 台給 351 條。
optionsEn: Correlator compute load scales linearly with the number of antennas.
FFT channels are independent of each other, so spectral leakage can be ignored.
The 64 ALMA antennas give 64×63/2 = 2016 baselines, 50 of the 12 m antennas give 1225 and the 27 VLA antennas give 351.
quiz.explanation: ALMA 64 台天線給 64×63/2 = 2016 條基線，50 台 12 m 天線給 1225 條，VLA 27 台給 351 條。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The 64 ALMA antennas give 64×63/2 = 2016 baselines, 50 of the 12 m antennas give 1225 and the 27 VLA antennas give 351. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 互相關、可見度與 (u,v) 取樣：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cross-correlation, visibility and (u,v) sampling: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「可見度與 (u,v) 平面」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Visibility and the (u,v) plane” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 觀測一顆點源校正器：校正後所有基線的可見度振幅應相同、相位應為零，與基線長度無關；畫出該次觀測的 (u,v) 覆蓋圖並與排程模擬比對；對點源計算閉合相位，應在雜訊內為零。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Observe a point-source calibrator: after calibration every baseline should show the same visibility amplitude and zero phase independent of baseline length; plot the (u,v) coverage of the observation and compare with the scheduling simulation; compute closure phases on the point source, which should be zero within noise. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：某台天線的位置若錯了數公分，與它相關的所有基線相位會隨時角與頻率變化，影像出現無法用天線增益校正掉的條紋狀假影；因為是基線相關誤差，閉合量也無法消除。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: An antenna position wrong by a few centimetres makes the phases of all its baselines vary with hour angle and frequency, producing striped artefacts that antenna-gain calibration cannot remove; because the error is baseline-based, closure quantities cannot remove it either.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 觀測一顆點源校正器：校正後所有基線的可見度振幅應相同、相位應為零，與基線長度無關；畫出該次觀測的 (u,v) 覆蓋圖並與排程模擬比對；對點源計算閉合相位，應在雜訊內為零。
knowledge.textEn: Observe a point-source calibrator: after calibration every baseline should show the same visibility amplitude and zero phase independent of baseline length; plot the (u,v) coverage of the observation and compare with the scheduling simulation; compute closure phases on the point source, which should be zero within noise.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「互相關、可見度與 (u,v) 取樣」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cross-correlation, visibility and (u,v) sampling"?
options: 觀測一顆點源校正器：校正後所有基線的可見度振幅應相同、相位應為零，與基線長度無關。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
GPS 時間已經夠準，所以不需要氫邁射。
optionsEn: Observe a point-source calibrator: after calibration every baseline should show the same visibility amplitude and zero phase independent of baseline length.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
GPS timing is accurate enough, so a hydrogen maser is unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 觀測一顆點源校正器：校正後所有基線的可見度振幅應相同、相位應為零，與基線長度無關；畫出該次觀測的 (u,v) 覆蓋圖並與排程模擬比對；對點源計算閉合相位，應在雜訊內為零。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Observe a point-source calibrator: after calibration every baseline should show the same visibility amplitude and zero phase independent of baseline length; plot the (u,v) coverage of the observation and compare with the scheduling simulation; compute closure phases on the point source, which should be zero within noise. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 互相關、可見度與 (u,v) 取樣：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cross-correlation, visibility and (u,v) sampling: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「可見度與 (u,v) 平面」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Visibility and the (u,v) plane” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 某台天線的位置若錯了數公分，與它相關的所有基線相位會隨時角與頻率變化，影像出現無法用天線增益校正掉的條紋狀假影；因為是基線相關誤差，閉合量也無法消除。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: An antenna position wrong by a few centimetres makes the phases of all its baselines vary with hour angle and frequency, producing striped artefacts that antenna-gain calibration cannot remove; because the error is baseline-based, closure quantities cannot remove it either. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：N 台天線同時提供 N(N−1)/2 條基線，地球自轉讓每條基線在 (u,v) 平面上掃出一道弧線，於是影像的解析度由最長基線決定、可偵測的最大角尺度由最短基線決定、視場則由單天線主波束決定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: N antennas provide N(N−1)/2 simultaneous baselines, Earth rotation sweeps each one along an arc in the (u,v) plane, so the image resolution is set by the longest baseline, the largest detectable angular scale by the shortest and the field of view by the single-dish primary beam.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每台天線各自成像後再疊加，就等於干涉陣列的影像。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Imaging with each antenna and co-adding equals the interferometric image." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

knowledge.title: 失效模式

steps.title: 延遲補償、條紋旋轉與相干損失：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Delay compensation, fringe rotation and coherence loss: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「幾何延遲與條紋旋轉」如何決定電波陣列相關器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Geometric delay and fringe rotation” determines the key performance of “Radio-array correlators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 同一波前到達不同天線的時間差 τ_g = B·ŝ/c 隨地球自轉連續改變，相關器必須在相乘之前以整數取樣加分數延遲把它補回來，並以條紋旋轉抵消因延遲變化而產生的自然條紋頻率，否則積分時訊號會自己抵消。殘餘延遲誤差 Δτ 在頻寬 Δν 上造成相位斜率，振幅按 sinc(πΔτΔν) 衰減；時間平均過長則造成視場邊緣的時間塗抹。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「幾何延遲與條紋旋轉」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The arrival-time difference of one wavefront at different antennas, τ_g = B·ŝ/c, changes continuously with Earth rotation, so the correlator must restore it before multiplying, using an integer-sample plus fractional delay, and must apply fringe rotation to cancel the natural fringe frequency produced by the changing delay, otherwise the signal averages itself away. A residual delay error Δτ produces a phase slope across the bandwidth Δν and the amplitude decays as sinc(πΔτΔν); too long a time average smears sources at the edge of the field. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Geometric delay and fringe rotation”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：基線 16 km：最大幾何延遲 16e3/3e8 = 53 µs，延遲變化率 ω_E·B/c = 7.29e−5×16e3/3e8 = 3.9 ns/s，230 GHz 的條紋頻率 = 2.3e11×3.9e−9 ≈ 900 Hz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a 16 km baseline the maximum geometric delay is 16e3/3e8 = 53 µs, the delay rate ω_E·B/c = 7.29e−5×16e3/3e8 = 3.9 ns/s and the fringe frequency at 230 GHz is 2.3e11×3.9e−9 ≈ 900 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「延遲可以在相關與平均之後再修正，不會損失相干性。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Delay can be corrected after correlation and averaging without losing coherence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 延遲補償、條紋旋轉與相干損失：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Delay compensation, fringe rotation and coherence loss: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「幾何延遲與條紋旋轉」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Geometric delay and fringe rotation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：基線 16 km：最大幾何延遲 16e3/3e8 = 53 µs，延遲變化率 ω_E·B/c = 7.29e−5×16e3/3e8 = 3.9 ns/s，230 GHz 的條紋頻率 = 2.3e11×3.9e−9 ≈ 900 Hz。要把 2 GHz 頻寬的相干損失限制在 1% 以內，需 πΔτΔν ≤ 0.245，即 Δτ ≤ 39 ps，而 4 GS/s 的取樣週期是 250 ps，所以必須做分數延遲。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a 16 km baseline the maximum geometric delay is 16e3/3e8 = 53 µs, the delay rate ω_E·B/c = 7.29e−5×16e3/3e8 = 3.9 ns/s and the fringe frequency at 230 GHz is 2.3e11×3.9e−9 ≈ 900 Hz. Keeping the coherence loss over a 2 GHz band below 1% requires πΔτΔν ≤ 0.245, i.e. Δτ ≤ 39 ps, while the sampling period at 4 GS/s is 250 ps, so fractional delay is mandatory. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對強校正器做條紋擬合，解出每台天線的殘餘延遲與延遲率；修正後檢查相位對頻率是否平坦（斜率對應 Δτ）、殘餘延遲是否低於 39 ps；再比較不同積分時間下視場邊緣點源的振幅，確認時間塗抹在預算內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fringe-fit a strong calibrator to solve the residual delay and delay rate per antenna; after correction check that phase versus frequency is flat (the slope corresponds to Δτ) and that residual delays are below 39 ps; then compare the amplitude of a point source at the field edge for different integration times to confirm time smearing stays within budget.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 延遲補償、條紋旋轉與相干損失：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Delay compensation, fringe rotation and coherence loss: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「幾何延遲與條紋旋轉」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Geometric delay and fringe rotation” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 對強校正器做條紋擬合，解出每台天線的殘餘延遲與延遲率；修正後檢查相位對頻率是否平坦（斜率對應 Δτ）、殘餘延遲是否低於 39 ps；再比較不同積分時間下視場邊緣點源的振幅，確認時間塗抹在預算內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fringe-fit a strong calibrator to solve the residual delay and delay rate per antenna; after correction check that phase versus frequency is flat (the slope corresponds to Δτ) and that residual delays are below 39 ps; then compare the amplitude of a point source at the field edge for different integration times to confirm time smearing stays within budget. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：時間戳記或取樣時脈滑掉一個樣本（250 ps），在 2 GHz 頻寬上產生半圈的相位斜率，該天線所有基線的寬頻振幅幾乎歸零，看起來像天線壞掉，其實是相關器端的延遲模型錯了。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A time-stamp or sampling-clock slip of one sample (250 ps) puts half a turn of phase slope across a 2 GHz band, the broadband amplitude on every baseline of that antenna collapses to near zero and it looks like a dead antenna when the fault is the correlator's delay model.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 時間戳記或取樣時脈滑掉一個樣本（250 ps），在 2 GHz 頻寬上產生半圈的相位斜率，該天線所有基線的寬頻振幅幾乎歸零，看起來像天線壞掉，其實是相關器端的延遲模型錯了。
knowledge.textEn: A time-stamp or sampling-clock slip of one sample (250 ps) puts half a turn of phase slope across a 2 GHz band, the broadband amplitude on every baseline of that antenna collapses to near zero and it looks like a dead antenna when the fault is the correlator's delay model.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「延遲補償、條紋旋轉與相干損失」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Delay compensation, fringe rotation and coherence loss" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
8 位元取樣比 3 位元靈敏度高很多，所以位元數越多越好。
時間戳記或取樣時脈滑掉一個樣本（250 ps），在 2 GHz 頻寬上產生半圈的相位斜率，該天線所有基線的寬頻振幅幾乎歸零，看起來像天線壞掉，其實是相關器端的延遲模型錯了。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
8-bit sampling is far more sensitive than 3-bit, so more bits are always better.
